rows.abstract: Rationale: "Saving the environment must be a continuing concern of every Filipino." Mandates the planting of trees in at least one (1) hectares of forest lands. rows.abstract: Rationale: "Our government has established programs and projects towards a clean environment, but the budget for this purpose is always not sufficient." Mandates all corporations, partnerships and individuals engaged in mine exploration and/or logging activities to CONTRIBUTE for the Fund. The rehabilitation of imbalanced environment and hazardous waste sites shall be made in accordance with the recommendation of the Environment Management Bureau.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECOLOGY since 1996-06-05

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A CLEAN AND GREEN ENVIRONMENT ACT OF 1996
rows.abstract: Provides for the following "SEC. 2. All persons are enjoined to clean and green their property including its immediate surroundings or premises such as streets, sidewalks or other roadsides. Such cleaning, disposal and collection of garbage and theplanting of trees shall be in coordination with the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) and the local government units concerned." "Sec. 3. All government units shall adopt and implement within six (6) months from the approval of this Act, a clean and green environment program within its territorial jurisdiction. Likewise, all government agencies shall adopt and implement its own clean and green environment program within six (6) months from the approval of this Act. Provides,, likewise, for the creation of a CLEAN AND GREEN ENVIRONMENT FUND for this purpose.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECOLOGY since 1996-06-05

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING A COMPREHENSIVE 'KAUNLARAN NG KABATAAN AT MAMAYAN DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM' TO PROMOTE THE PHYSICAL, INTELLECTUAL AND SOCIAL WELL-BEING OF YOUNG PEOPLE, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Proposes to establish a comprehensive Youth Development Program.  It seeks to promote the involvement of the youth in character building and development activities for civic efficency, self-improvemen t and economic well being. The program is composed of various componenets such as: sports development, scholarship, livelihood training and cooperative organization. These areas of development will provide our youth the necessary opportunities to discover their social and economic potentials to become self-reliant, productive and responsible citizens of the country.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on YOUTH AND SPORTS DEVELOPMENT since 1996-06-06

rows.author: A083
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING AS NONWORKING HOLIDAY ALL HOLIDAYS OF RELIGIOUS OBSERVANCE OF ANY SECT OR DENOMINATION
rows.abstract: Declares that --- "SECTION 1. All holidays of religioud observance of any religious sect or denomination, whether Catholic, Protestant, Islam or others are hereby declared as non-working holidays throughout the Phiippines. All employees professing the religion which is celebrating the holiday on such specific day shall be entitled to leave tith full pay."
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 1996-06-06

rows.author: A083
rows.title_full: AN ACT EXPANDING THE JURISDICTION OF THE SHARI'A CIRCUIT COURTS TO INCLUDE CASES BETWEEN MUSLIMS AND NONMUSLIMS AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE CODE OF MUSLIM PERSONAL LAWS OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Rationale: "Under the existing laws, the Civil Courts shall have jurisdiction of cases between Muslims and non-Muslims. It is felt however, that there is a significant difference between Muslim personal laws and those of other communities. Cases ofthese nature, being of cultural values, must be considered in the light of the Muslim personal laws."
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1996-06-06

rows.author: A007
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6657 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS 'AN ACT INSTITUTING A COMPREHENSIVE AGRARIAN REFORM LAW'
rows.abstract: Seeks to hasten to hasten the process of land valuation in accordance with existing laws in force now and before martial law in order that the Government may distribute properties lawfully acquired after complying with the Constitutional mandate topay just compensation for private property taken under agrarian reform program.  This bill will remove the valid apprehension and doubts of the beneficiaries whether the titles issued to them by the Government over lands not lawfully acquired by it are really owned by them.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRARIAN REFORM since 1996-06-06
